commentary.text: 90+7' Jose Sanchez is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Jose Sanchez interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Marc Pubill (Almeria).
90+3' Wow, what an escape. Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
90+3' The attendance is 18005.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Jose Sanchez shows the yellow card to Aleksandar Radovanovic (Almeria) for a heavy challenge.
89' We are about to witness a subsitution. Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) for Luca de la Torre.
89' That's the end of the game for Oscar Mingueza, who is replaced by Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo).
88' Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
85' The current number of shots on goal is 5:0.
83' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
81' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
79' Today's match ends for Manu Sanchez who will be replaced by Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo).
78' A yellow card for a tackle by Dion Lopy (Almeria). Jose Sanchez doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.

78' Luis Maximiano was forced into action to thwart Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
75' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.

73' 1 - 0 Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) produces a wonderful finish! He received a pass from Manu Sanchez and unleashed a fantastic long-range strike into the bottom left corner via the post. The score is 1:0.
71' The main referee, Jose Sanchez, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Manu Sanchez (Celta Vigo) is given a yellow card for dissent.
68' Here is a change. Jonathan Viera is going off and Gaizka Garitano gives the last tactical orders to Dion Lopy (Almeria).
68' Substitution. Lucas Robertone leaves the pitch and is replaced by Alejandro Centelles Plaza (Almeria).
65' What an awful challenge. The referee Jose Sanchez has no other option than to send Bruno Langa (Almeria) off the pitch. Red card!
63' Substitution. Largie Ramazani (Almeria) has come on for Adrian Embarba.
63' Gaizka Garitano decides to make a substitution. Choco Lozano will be replaced by Sergio Arribas (Almeria).
63' The linesman raises his flag. Jonathan Viera (Almeria) is adjudged offside.
62' Celta Vigo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
60' Substitution. Tadeo Allende (Celta Vigo) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Anastasios Douvikas walks off.
59' Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
55' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Luis Maximiano.
51' Oscar Mingueza puts Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) in the clear, but he completely fluffs his lines from mid-range and sends a shot well wide of the left post.

49' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the top left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop the effort.
49' The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+7' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+3' Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) latches onto a precise lofted pass into the penalty area and produces a header at goal, but his attempt to the left side of the target fails to beat Luis Maximiano, who makes a sensational save.
45+2' It looks like Luka Romero may be concussed after that challenge from an opposing player. He’s definitely coming off in line and Gaizka Garitano replaces him with Leo Baptistao (Almeria).
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Looks like Luka Romero (Almeria) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
44' Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
40' Aleksandar Radovanovic (Almeria) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
39' Aleksandar Radovanovic (Almeria) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
36' Bruno Langa (Almeria) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar.

36' What a great touch by Bruno Langa (Almeria)! He picks up a precise pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot on goal. His effort, however, only rattles the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
35' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Luis Maximiano, who smothers the ball.
33' The corner is swung in but Celta Vigo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
32' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. Celta Vigo earn a corner.
31' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Adrian Embarba (Almeria) heads on.
27' Edgar Gonzalez (Almeria) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jose Sanchez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
23' The goal by Celta Vigo won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
22' Wait! Referee Jose Sanchez has indicated he is going to review the Celta Vigo goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
21' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a clinical finish!
20' A quickly taken corner by Celta Vigo.
18' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jose Sanchez blows for a foul.
18' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Vicente Guaita comes off the line to clear the ball away.
17' A corner kick by Celta Vigo is thwarted by the well prepared Luis Maximiano (Almeria).
10' Some patient build-up play from Celta Vigo as they look to unlock the defence.
8' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) leaps high deep inside the box to meet a beautiful cross from the resultant free kick. He glances a header goalwards, but it goes narrowly wide of the right post.
4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Celta Vigo comes to nothing.
3' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Bruno Langa (Almeria).
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Celta Vigo will have the kick-off.
Jose Sanchez is introduced as the referee for today's match.
